## Goal
Make every operator-run AWS command in rebar's own docs work as written. This deployment's AWS account (896586841071, us-east-1) is reached only through the `frontier` AWS CLI profile; an `aws` or `terraform` command run without it fails, because the default credential chain has no credentials for that account. Today only `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/README.md` passes `--profile frontier`. The other runbooks' `aws ...` commands, the Terraform runbooks (the Terraform providers pin no profile), and the local-setup TL;DR (`export AWS_PROFILE=...`) leave it out.

## Scope (from a `git grep` inventory of `aws <service> <op>` across *.md and *.sh, 134 lines)
- **Change:** every command an operator runs from their own shell in `infra/runbooks/*.md` (bedrock-access, bedrock-ci-oidc, g2p-ci-credentials, gate-scratch-mount, gerrit-auth-hardening, gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost, gerrit-object-store-repair, gerrit-upgrade, mcp-client-pats, provision-restore, review-bot-ops, ssm-secret-write-only, sso-auth-host) gets `--profile frontier` right after `aws <service> <op>`, including concrete inline commands such as "`aws ssm put-parameter --overwrite …`".
- **Leave unchanged, with reason:**
  - Commands that run ON the instance, which authenticates with its instance role and has no `frontier` profile; the flag would make them fail. These are the `aws bedrock-runtime converse` inside the `send-command` payload in bedrock-access.md, and every `infra/**/*.sh` script (`infra/scripts/observability.sh`, `fetch-secrets.sh`, `materialize-opcert-guard.sh`, `infra/terraform/user_data.sh`, `infra/gerrit/*.sh`).
  - Prose that describes a command's behaviour rather than giving one to run (gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost.md lines 4-5, gerrit-data-volume-reclaim.md line 44).
  - Adopter-facing docs written for other organisations' accounts (`docs/s3-backend.md`, `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md`, `docs/llm-framework.md`, `docs/llm-example-configs.md`), where `frontier` would be wrong for the reader.
  - Accepted ADRs (0008, 0059, 0061), which are historical records, and `.rebar/prompts/`.
- `AGENTS.md`: a short paragraph beside the Gerrit credential guidance. It says that every `aws` command against this deployment passes `--profile frontier` (us-east-1), that Terraform under `infra/` needs `export AWS_PROFILE=frontier` because no provider pins a profile, and that commands run on the instance take no profile.
- `docs/local-dev-env.md` TL;DR: `export AWS_PROFILE=frontier` in place of `export AWS_PROFILE=...`.

## Verification
- A re-run of the inventory grep, filtered to `infra/runbooks/`, shows every remaining `aws <service> <op>` line without `--profile frontier` is one of the listed exclusions.
- `make lint` passes, plus the doc-scanning tests touching AGENTS.md and docs (`pytest tests/unit -q -k "agents_md or docs_ or runbook"`). CI's Verified vote covers the full suite.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Every operator-shell `aws` command in `infra/runbooks/*.md` passes `--profile frontier`; the only lines without it are the listed exclusions.
- [x] AGENTS.md states the `--profile frontier` rule, the `AWS_PROFILE=frontier` requirement for Terraform, and the on-instance exception.
- [x] docs/local-dev-env.md's TL;DR exports `AWS_PROFILE=frontier`.
- [x] The change is merged on main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

## File impact (expected)
- AGENTS.md
- docs/local-dev-env.md
- infra/runbooks/*.md (the 13 listed)
